messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-generation-prod p99 latency breached (config: realtime.slo=2000ms). p95=1.1s -> 1.9s, p99=2.3s -> 4.1s over last 3m. Streaming partial-responses ↑ 0.6% -> 4.7%. Paging oncall.
alex (oncall): on it. pulling up dashboards now — link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/realtime/p99?range=5m
maria (sre_lead): thanks @alex. quick triage checklist: 1) confirm customer impact 2) check proxy backpressure warnings 3) check GPU/IO and ingress queueing. anyone seeing deploys or recent config changes?
jonah (eng-runtime): no deploys in last 30m from the deploy bot. I see a flurry of 1-token-but-many-requests traffic from a single IP range, maybe a retry loop. headers show 'x-client-retries: 4'.
tess (devex): paging CS for customers with high SLA tier. cs-bridge-bot, please open a ticket for any customers with >1% error or increased latency and post to #customer-impact.
cs-bridge-bot: created INC-5952 and notified Accounts: AcmeCorp, BrightShop. ETA for initial outreach: 20m.
alex (oncall): grabbing logs — proxy reports repeated 'connection_backpressure: applied' and 'upstream_queue_timeout' on a subset of instances. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T13:12:04Z] proxy: connection_backpressure applied on host gpu-12-3 (zone-a)
[2026-03-15T13:12:07Z] runtime: request_enqueue_time 412ms, dequeue_wait 1.1s
[2026-03-15T13:12:09Z] streaming: partial-chunk-timeout for session 0x7f2a
```
maria (sre_lead): that points at ingress queueing / backpressure, likely caused by bursty small requests overwhelming batching. can we temporarily reduce batch_window and enforce a max_concurrency per-worker?
jonah (eng-runtime): I can flip emergency config: set batch_window_ms from 40 -> 10, and max_concurrency 16 -> 8 for realtime-prod. Doing a controlled change on 3 instances first.
alex (oncall): go ahead jonah. also enable model-fallback-rule to fallback-model=gpt-lite-v2 for generation-route if latency > 2s for 2m.
jonah (eng-runtime): applying change now to canary subset (gpu-12-3, gpu-12-4, gpu-12-5). commands:
```
api set-config --env realtime-prod --service runtime --patch '{"batch_window_ms":10,"max_concurrency":8}' --targets canary
api set-fallback --route /generate --model gpt-lite-v2 --trigger 'p99>2000ms for 120s'
```
alex (oncall): checking nvidia util on the canary hosts — `nvidia-smi` shows 78% util -> 95% util on gpu-12-3 prior to change, memory stable. suggests CPU/proxy queuing rather than gpu saturation.
maria (sre_lead): good. also temporarily increase ingress token bucket to absorb retry storms: `proxy.rate_limit.retry_backoff=200ms` and enable `client-retry-throttle=true`.
tess (devex): I've posted a short PSAT to #status-page: "We are investigating increased latency for realtime generation. Some requests may see degraded responsiveness. Working on mitigation; updates in 15m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex (oncall): after config patch on canary, p99 on canary hosts dropped from 3.9s -> 1.8s in 45s. still high on rest of cluster. jonah, can you roll to remainder with 2-min monitoring window?
jonah (eng-runtime): rolling to remaining pool now. watchlist: zone-b hosts with older kernel may show longer dequeue waits.
maria (sre_lead): assign incident triage owner: alex. severity: sev3->sev2 (customer impact on paid tiers). notify oncall-sre-mgr if no reduction in 10m.
alex (oncall): noted. @tess please get CS to send proactive note to AcmeCorp POC with mitigation steps taken. Also add a short mention to status page noting affected regions.
tess (devex): sending now. CS confirmed they will escalate if Acme reports user-visible outages.
cs-bridge-bot: AcmeCorp POC emailed. BrightShop POC flagged as monitoring only.
alex (oncall): quick followups: 1) collect top 10 client IPs causing retries 2) save heap/profile from one of the overloaded proxies 3) open infra task to add slow-request circuit-breaker for retries. I'll create a short runbook entry.
maria (sre_lead): good plan. action items -> alex (runbook + customer update), jonah (rollout + telemetry), tess (CS comms). if p99 does not drop under 2s across cluster in 10m, page oncall-sre-mgr.
alex (oncall): p99 cluster-wide now 1.6s after full rollout, streaming partials down to 0.9%. keeping this thread open for 30m monitoring. starting incident timeline in ops-docs: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/6350001111
jonah (eng-runtime): noted. I'll follow up with PR to make `max_concurrency` tunable per-model and add automated rollback if p99 spikes on rollout.
maria (sre_lead): nice mitigation. postmortem owner: jonah + alex. closing initial triage — will keep watch. :white_check_mark:
